verdict.rationale: Filee is an offline desktop file converter. A built-in assistant is a plausible feature for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents drag-and-drop conversion, presets, watch folders and a CLI, but nothing about a built-in AI assistant that takes delegated tasks. The CLI and automatic multi-step routing are developer or automation building blocks, not an AI assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
